_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision this sim/ tree's committed evidence records were generated against. Every record under sim/*/records/*.md must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it). Not consumed by tooling; kept as a plain, greppable fact sheet -- mirrors sg13g2-bandgap's sim/pdk.json convention (same PDK, same pinned release, confirmed by matching .fetched-version content).
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)
confirmed_via: installed checkout's own .fetched-version file reads '0.3.0', checked directly during issue #6 (see sim/device-mismatch-confirm/README.md)

osdi_toolchain._comment: Provenance of the OSDI (Verilog-A compact model) binaries the sg13_lv_nmos/sg13_lv_pmos subckts load (psp103va). sim/device-mismatch-confirm/README.md 'Reproducing' documents the build recipe if psp103.osdi is not already present under PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi -- same recipe sg13g2-bandgap's sim/tools/build-osdi.sh uses.
osdi_toolchain.install_dir: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi (PDK-install territory, not tracked in this repo)
osdi_toolchain.ngspice_actually_used: ngspice-46, confirmed with OSDI support (loads psp103.osdi via pre_osdi with no error)
